item.title: emacs31: fix CVE-2024-53920
item.description:
Unfortunately, Emacs' fix for the CVE-2024-53920 arbitrary code execution vulnerability was incomplete and the upstream maintainers just announced an updated patch for it on their mailing list.

This means that the Emacs currently contained in nixpkgs is subject to an arbitrary code execution vulnerability.

The patch contained here is taken directly from the mailing list. Unfortuantely, we cannot fetch the patch via. git, as the fix in their main git branch is a bit more relaxed than this one.
